description: Sends input to the open page, frame by frame: { key, down?, frames? }, { mouse: click|down|up|move, x, y }, { touch: start|move|end|tap, x, y }, { wait: frames, draw? } or { action, ...args } for window.__game.act; draw: false on a long wait runs its frames without drawing all but the last (much faster; leave it out when the picture builds up over frames, like trails). Each step advances `frames` (default 1). Returns the state after and what changed; with `look: true` also game_look's picture and list after the steps, in the same reply.

look.description: Also return game_look's picture after the steps.

name: game_act
